sources.games: 1007 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 51.6%. STRATZ pos4/pos5 have no build for him (3050 games). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py clockwerk.
sources.items: No item rule: the build is from the games; Valve /datafeed/itemdata not needed.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 100% (2), tranquil_boots 86% (9), magic_wand 74% (10), urn_of_shadows 35% (12), essence_distiller 26% (17), pavise 21% (20), staff_of_wizardry 65% (24), great_famango 26% (24), blink 48% (26), cyclone 29% (26), force_staff 40% (27), aghanims_shard 34% (30), ghost 25% (31), greater_famango 21% (39). Reviewed: the draft as is. No rule: no group has a candidate with a clear signal (Spirit Vessel against targeted jumpers is 5 buys in 29 games and won 20%; Ghost Scepter against jumpers 35% vs 24% of 52 games is asked).

skills.basis: 1007 games since 7.41: maxed rattletrap_power_cogs > rattletrap_rocket_flare > rattletrap_battery_assault 676 (win 59.5%), rattletrap_power_cogs > rattletrap_rocket_flare 172 (win 29.7%), rattletrap_power_cogs > rattletrap_battery_assault > rattletrap_rocket_flare 48 (win 60.4%); talents 10: +1.5 Mana Regen 626/980 (56.2%), Hookshot Damage 354/980 (46.6%); 15: Hookshot Cooldown 666/713 (62.6%), Battery Assault Damage 47/713 (61.7%); 20: Rocket Flare True Sight 258/309 (67.8%), Power Cogs Mana Burn 51/309 (66.7%); 25: Rocket Flare Charges 57/64 (70.2%), Battery Assault Interval 7/64 (57.1%).

notes.basis: Valve Power Cogs (fetched 2026-11-07): a ring of cogs traps units near Clockwerk and knocks back and burns the ones touching it; note 'Cogs can shock invisible units'. 5-8 s, 15-21 s cooldown.

reason.en: {enemy} can go invisible: Power Cogs shock invisible units and trap them inside the ring, so cast them on top of the fight
reason.uk: {enemy} може ставати невидимим: Power Cogs б'ють невидимих і замикають їх у кільці, тож ставте їх просто в бійку
